# Lint Integration Tests — all 13 checks plus --json and exit codes

# --- Input files ---

-- good-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Good Note
summary: A well-formed note for testing
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-04-21'
---
This is a well-formed note with proper frontmatter.
-- good-note.md --

-- broken-link-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Broken Link Note
summary: Note with a broken wikilink
tags: linttest
---
This note links to [[nonexistent-page]].
-- broken-link-note.md --

-- adr-missing-status.md --
---
type: adr
title: Missing Status ADR
summary: ADR without required status field
deciders: team
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-04-21'
---
Decision without status.
-- adr-missing-status.md --

-- adr-invalid-status.md --
---
type: adr
title: Invalid Status ADR
status: invalid
summary: ADR with invalid status enum value
deciders: team
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-04-21'
---
Decision with bad status.
-- adr-invalid-status.md --

-- bad-confidence-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Bad Confidence
summary: Note with invalid confidence value
tags: linttest
confidence: super-high
---
Content with bad confidence.
-- bad-confidence-note.md --

-- short-summary-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Short Summary
summary: Hi
tags: linttest
---
Content with too-short summary.
-- short-summary-note.md --

-- stale-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Stale Page
summary: A page with an old updated date
tags: linttest
updated: '2020-01-01'
---
Old content that is stale.
-- stale-note.md --

-- provenance-drift-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Provenance Drift
summary: Note with provenance drift
tags: linttest
provenance:
  inferred: 0.9
---
Some content without provenance markers.
Another line of content.
A third line here.
-- provenance-drift-note.md --

-- cited-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Cited Note
summary: Note referencing a missing source
tags: linttest
sources: missing-file.csv
---
Content citing a non-manifest file.
-- cited-note.md --

-- empty-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Empty Note
summary: An empty page with no body
tags: linttest
---

-- empty-note.md --

# ============================================================
# Section 1: All 13 checks in one KB
# ============================================================

exec akb init lint-kb
cd lint-kb

# --- Write pages via akb write (tracked in link graph) ---

exec akb write broken-note.md <../broken-link-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/broken-note.md'

exec akb write empty-note.md <../empty-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/empty-note.md'

exec akb write bad-adr.md <../adr-missing-status.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/bad-adr.md'

exec akb write invalid-status-adr.md <../adr-invalid-status.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/invalid-status-adr.md'

exec akb write bad-confidence.md <../bad-confidence-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/bad-confidence.md'

exec akb write short-summary.md <../short-summary-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/short-summary.md'

exec akb write stale.md <../stale-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/stale.md'

exec akb write prov-drift.md <../provenance-drift-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/prov-drift.md'

exec akb write cited-note.md <../cited-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/cited-note.md'

# --- Write pages directly to kb/ (bypassing akb write) ---

# missing_frontmatter: file without YAML delimiters
exec sh -c 'echo "No frontmatter here" > kb/no-frontmatter.md'

# type_exists: page with unknown type (akb write rejects unknown types)
exec sh -c 'mkdir -p kb/notes && cat > kb/notes/bad-type.md <<EOF
---
type: nonexistent
title: Unknown Type
summary: Bad type page
tags: linttest
---
Content with bad type.
EOF'

# category_dirs: note-type page outside kb/notes/
exec sh -c 'mkdir -p kb/random && cat > kb/random/misplaced.md <<EOF
---
type: note
title: Misplaced
summary: In wrong directory
tags: linttest
---
Content in wrong dir.
EOF'

# --- Run lint once and verify all 13 check types appear ---

! exec akb lint

# 1. broken_links
stdout 'broken_links'

# 2. orphans
stdout 'orphans'

# 3. empty_pages
stdout 'empty_pages'

# 4. missing_frontmatter
stdout 'missing_frontmatter'

# 5. index_consistency
stdout 'index_consistency'

# 6. type_exists
stdout 'type_exists'

# 7. frontmatter_schema (missing required field)
stdout 'frontmatter_schema'

# 8. frontmatter_schema (invalid enum value — same check name)
stdout 'frontmatter_schema'

# 9. category_dirs
stdout 'category_dirs'

# 10. citations
stdout 'citations'

# 11. confidence
stdout 'confidence'

# 12. summary_length
stdout 'summary_length'

# 13. provenance
stdout 'provenance'

# 14. freshness
stdout 'freshness'

# Verify summary line
stdout 'issue(s) found'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: --json output
# ============================================================

! exec akb lint --json
stdout '"issues"'
stdout '"summary"'
stdout '"by_check"'

# ============================================================
# Section 3: Clean lint — well-formed page with no critical issues
# ============================================================

cd ..

exec akb init clean-kb
cd clean-kb

exec akb write good-note.md <../good-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/good-note.md'

exec akb index add kb/notes/good-note.md 'A well-formed note'

# Lint will still exit 1 due to orphans, but must NOT have
# broken_links, missing_frontmatter, type_exists, or frontmatter_schema
! exec akb lint
! stdout 'broken_links'
! stdout 'missing_frontmatter'
! stdout 'type_exists'
! stdout 'frontmatter_schema'

# ============================================================
# Section 4: Empty KB — no pages at all
# ============================================================

cd ..

exec akb init empty-kb
cd empty-kb

exec akb lint
stdout 'No issues found.'

# ============================================================
# Section 5: Missing DB — actionable error message
# ============================================================

cd ..

exec akb init nodb-kb
cd nodb-kb

exec rm .akb/search.db

! exec akb lint
stderr 'akb init'
